memories.content: Grids are plunge-frozen on the Vitrobot Mark IV at 4 degrees Celsius and 100% humidity with a 4-second blot.
A 2-second blot produced grids that were too thin and collapsed in the beam; the 4-second blot is now the standard.
Ingrid lives with her husband Daniel Reyes and their son Mateo in a rented two-bedroom flat in Bakklandet, Trondheim.

relations.fact: Ingrid lives in a flat in Bakklandet
Daniel Reyes is Ingrid's husband
Mateo Reyes is Ingrid's son

memories.content: Daniel Reyes is Ingrid Solberg's husband and a luthier who builds and repairs guitars from the workshop under the family flat.

relations.fact: Daniel Reyes works as a luthier

memories.content: Mateo started at Bakklandet primary school at age eight.
Akta Pure 25 columns are stored in 20% ethanol and flushed with five column volumes of water before use.
Yusuf Adeyemi joined the lab as a postdoc leading single-particle data processing.
The Fjord compute cluster has eight A100 GPUs shared across all image-processing projects.

relations.fact: Fjord has eight A100 GPUs

memories.content: Weekly group meeting runs on Tuesdays at 10:00 in the Biophysics Annexe seminar room.
A power cut overnight killed a -80 freezer in the cold room and thawed two months of Rafael's purified Lon samples.
Protein is now split into aliquots across two separate -80 freezers, and the alarm autodialler is tested monthly.
The failed cold-room freezer was replaced with a Stirling-engine -80 unit under the service contract.
Lon constructs are expressed in E. coli BL21(DE3), captured on Ni-NTA and polished by size-exclusion chromatography.

relations.fact: Lon is expressed in E. coli BL21(DE3)

memories.content: Zoe Lindqvist joined as a PhD student working on molecular dynamics simulations of Lon.
The lab moved from RELION 4 to RELION 5 because Bayesian polishing halved helical reconstruction time.
Ingrid's mother Astrid Solberg celebrated her 78th birthday in Bergen.
Grant drafts go to two internal reviewers at least two weeks before the funder deadline.
The ClpXP substrate-handoff paper was accepted by the Journal of Molecular Biology.
The Lon E240Q mutant abolishes ATP hydrolysis but still binds substrate.

relations.fact: Lon E240Q abolishes ATP hydrolysis

memories.content: Using R1.2/1.3 grids for the Lon sample wasted an EM session; R2/1 grids match the particle size.

Lucia Ferrante runs the NMR facility at the University of Bologna and collaborates on the Lon allostery project.

Physio routine: band external rotations and scapular retractions three times a week, and no overhead pressing.
Ben Osei joined as an undergraduate researcher for a final-year project on ClpXP.
Prof. Kenji Watanabe from the Kyoto Institute of Technology visited for a week to plan cryo-ET of Lon filaments.
